title.narrative: Output 7.2. Increased capacity of member States to ensure safe and healthy working conditions

description.narrative: The Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare has officially established OSH Committee at central with Prime Minister's Agreement and provincial OSH committee with the provincial governors' agreements to implement National Occupational Safety Decree and related works. With support from Government of Korea, the ILO provided support to the design and development of national Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) profile, which has been endorsed by tripartite constitutions in 2021. The ILO support included reviewing the drafts and facilitating tripartite consultations. The updated National OSH Profile is an important effort of Lao PDR to improve its national occupational safety and health system and preparation for the ratification of the Promotional Framework for Occupational Safety and Health Convention, 2006 (No.187) and the Occupational Safety and Health Convention, 1981 (No.155). With support of EC and Government of Germany, the ILO provided support to develop the capacity of labour inspectors on Occupational Safety and Health hazards and risks in the garment industry and in agriculture and by providing training on Occupational Safety and Health inspection skills and the national Occupational Safety and Health Decree. These activities support the enforcement of Occupational Safety and Health legal requirements and Occupational Safety and Health compliance improvements in the workplace. In responding to the COVID-19 pandemic, the ILO supported efforts to improve COVID-19 infection prevention measures, i.e. providing technical advice on health protocol, training OSH Committees in factories, supporting the provision and monitoring the use of PPE. The ILO also helped developing the capacity of the partners on Occupational Safety and Health skills, supporting the rollout of Occupational Safety and Health knowledge by partner organisations to end beneficiaries, and developing and disseminating Occupational Safety and Health training material.
